name: viber-messaging-mcp
description: Viber (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_viber_auth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_AUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_viber_auth_token.description: Bot authentication token ('Each API request must include an HTTP Header called X-Viber-Auth-Token containing the account's authentication token'), shown in the bot's edit-info screen / Viber Admin Panel.

platform_mcp_viber_sender_name.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIBER_SENDER_NAME
platform_mcp_viber_sender_name.description: sender.name shown with every message ('required. Max 28 characters').

tools.name: me
tools.description: get_account_info: id, name, uri, icon, subscribers_count, webhook.

tools.name: send
tools.description: `to` is the Viber user id of a subscriber (from a webhook callback); only subscribed users can be messaged. message_id is Viber's message_token. A non-zero Viber status (e.g. 6 notSubscribed) is an isError result.
